## 2. Core Technical Stacks & Competencies

### Frontend & Web Technologies
- **Next.js 15 & React 19**: Server Components (RSC), Streaming SSR, App Router, incremental static regeneration (ISR), Edge middleware, sub-second TTFB.
- **Astro 5**: Island architecture (`client:visible`, `client:load`), zero-JS static HTML defaults, 100/100 Google Lighthouse Core Web Vitals.
- **Styling & Animation**: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP scroll-triggered animations, Apple-grade cubic bezier spring physics, modern dark-mode luxury aesthetics.
- **Performance Optimization**: Speculation Rules API for instant pre-rendering on hover, high-priority image preloading (`fetchpriority="high"`), lazy hydration.

### Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)
- **Google Flutter (Dart)**: Single codebase compilation to native ARM machine code for iOS and Android, rendering directly via Skia / Impeller engines at 60fps/120fps.
- **State Management**: BLoC / Cubit, Riverpod, Provider, GetX.
- **Native Device APIs**: Camera, GPS/geofencing, Bluetooth BLE, Biometrics (Face ID/Fingerprint), Push Notifications (FCM, APNs), In-App Purchases, offline SQLite/Hive storage.
- **App Store Lifecycle**: End-to-end App Store Optimization (ASO), Apple App Store & Google Play Store publishing, review compliance.

### Backend & API Architectures
- **Node.js & NestJS**: Modular TypeScript architecture, dependency injection, enterprise microservices, clean architecture patterns.
- **Express.js & REST APIs**: High-throughput RESTful services, strict input validation (Zod, Joi), rate limiting, and JWT authentication.
- **Real-Time Communication**: WebSockets, Socket.io, Server-Sent Events (SSE) for instant messaging, live driver tracking, and real-time dashboard analytics.
- **PHP & Laravel**: Monolithic portals, Blade templating, Eloquent ORM, and enterprise admin panels.

### Database Engineering & DevOps
- **Relational Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase, TimescaleDB for time-series data, Prisma ORM, automated daily backups.
- **NoSQL & In-Memory**: MongoDB, Redis for high-speed sub-10ms query caching, session management, and BullMQ task queues.
- **Cloud Infrastructure**: Amazon Web Services (EC2, S3, RDS, CloudFront), DigitalOcean Droplets, Cloudflare CDN, Docker containerization, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.

### Artificial Intelligence & Automation
- **Generative AI & LLMs**: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, open-source Llama 3 via Ollama/Groq.
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**: Grounding LLMs in enterprise PDFs, catalogs, and databases using LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, and PostgreSQL `pgvector`.
- **Meta WhatsApp Cloud API**: Official Cloud API provisioning, green tick verification consulting, interactive message templates, automated customer support, and catalog checkouts.

## 4. International Client Advantage: UAE & GCC Focus

Anagh K R has established streamlined workflows for clients in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC):

1. **Strategic Time Zone Alignment**: Kerala (IST, UTC+5:30) is just 1.5 hours ahead of Dubai/UAE (GST, UTC+4:00) and 2.5 hours ahead of Saudi Arabia & Qatar (AST, UTC+3:00). This provides full working day overlap for live Slack, WhatsApp, and Google Meet meetings.
2. **60%–70% Budget Optimization**: Retaining senior in-house developers or major digital agencies in Dubai or Riyadh requires AED 25,000 to AED 50,000+ per month, plus visa, insurance, and gratuity obligations. Working remotely with Anagh K R yields superior engineering standards at a fraction of the capital investment.
3. **Bilingual & Localization Ready**: Systems built with native Right-to-Left (RTL) Arabic typography, regional currency handling (AED, SAR, QAR, KWD, OMR, BHD), and regional payment gateways (Telr, Tap Payments, PayTabs, KNET, Mada).
4. **100% Intellectual Property Ownership**: Full source code transferred on private client GitHub repositories with clean documentation and zero vendor lock-in.

## 5. Notable Production Works & Case Studies

1. **DamMonitor (Kerala Real-Time Dam Monitoring System)**:
   - Live URL: https://www.anaghkr.in/blog/dammonitor-kerala-dam-monitoring-app-real-time-water-levels-2026/
   - Description: Real-time flood warning and reservoir level tracker serving 10,000+ active residents during monsoon seasons across Kerala.
   - Stack: Flutter mobile, Node.js background scrapers, automated alert triggers.

2. **QuickTransfer (Mac & Android High-Speed Offline File Sharing)**:
   - Live URL: https://www.anaghkr.in/blog/quicktransfer-mac-android-offline-file-sharing/
   - Description: Local Wi-Fi peer-to-peer file transfer utility enabling ultra-fast file moves between macOS and Android without internet access.
   - Stack: Flutter, Golang/Dart sockets, zero cloud dependency.

3. **Enterprise Dispatch & Logistics Fleet Portal**:
   - Description: Real-time driver dispatch dashboard with GPS tracking, multi-currency invoicing, and customer SMS/WhatsApp status updates.
   - Stack: Next.js, Node.js, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, Leaflet maps.
